old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-npdw","title":"Relay dedup entries never expire and permit authenticated preplay suppression","description":"Security review of the rl7e fix in python/src/lichen/node.py found _relay_identity is collision-free over normalized IPv6 bytes, but _relay_seen has no time domain or expiry. Exact legitimate repeat datagrams remain suppressed until capacity eviction, and an authenticated peer can spoof/predict a victim's full IPv6 datagram, seed or refresh the LRU entry, and make the later genuine datagram disappear indefinitely. Define a bounded replay window/expiry based on a monotonic clock and an authenticated end-to-end packet identity or explicit packet nonce where available, without reintroducing hop/SCHC encoding instability; test stale-entry expiry, repeated legitimate datagrams, and adversarial preplay refresh.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:00:07.198958Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:00:07.198958Z"}
